title: Leila's Cakes Beside the Stew
youtube_title: Leila's Cakes Beside the Stew | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing food means putting different dishes where people can enjoy them together.
summary: Leila brings a basket of corn cakes to the harvest supper and sees Mrs. Nguyen's stew has bread that ran out. She splits her cakes so people can taste cake and stew together.
